title: Validation
endBeforeStart: End date must be on or after the start date
dateInPast: Date can’t be in the past
dateInFuture: Date can’t be in the future

hexColor: Enter a valid hex color, e.g. #0F5E6B

codeTaken: This code is already in use
atLeastOneName: Enter the name in Arabic or English
